interface.longDescription: Signed, offline-verifiable authorization for AI-agent contract changes. Call preflight_change_set before merge, deploy, publish, or tool registration when a contract artifact changed; branch on execution_action only; use verify_receipt for a receipt you already hold and get_decision_details for a past decision. Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://app.coderifts.com/mcp exposes exactly those three tools. Only a granted change can proceed.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this OpenAPI change before merge
Verify the CodeRifts receipt I already hold
Look up a past CodeRifts decision by id
